snippet.title: Dune Rancher - Announcement Trailer (Incremental Strategy RPG - NOW ON STEAM)
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4319210/Dune_Rancher/

The firth game for the Shipping 24 Games in 24 Months on Steam - now has a store page LIVE! 

It would be super lovely to see you checking it out, but also consider wishlisting the game! 

This game has been a much bigger challenge than the previous ones. Main reason is because I decided to try creating a 3D game on Construct 3. Unfortunately, the engine is not ready for that. Construct 3 is designed to be a 2D engine and the latest 3D feature is still incomplete for "professional game development". 

Because of this, this will most likely be the first and last 3D game you see me developing within a while. But after yesterdays development crunch, I'm not more comfortable in moving forward since I got the game in a pretty good shape.

Remember to join our Discord for further discussions: https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y
